## Summary

Gaurav Sahitya is a software engineer (SDE-II) based in Bengaluru, India. He designs and scales distributed backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices. He specializes in REST API latency optimization, AWS cloud integrations, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. Documented impact includes 35%+ API latency reduction, platforms serving 10,000+ monthly users, an automation engine processing 5,000+ requests/month, and invoice ingestion of 1,000+ documents/month with zero data loss.

- Architected a Spring Boot automation engine processing 5,000+ requests/month, cutting manual support overhead by 60%.
- Integrated OpenAI and AWS Textract for automated document ingestion of 1,000+ invoices/month with zero data loss.
- Implemented administrative filtering via Spring AOP, improving backend data-retrieval speeds by 30%.
- Uses Cursor and Amazon Q to accelerate business-logic prototyping and unit-test validation.
